_comment: Staff roles for the office. A role runs as a read-only claude -p with its own tool allowlist and may only PROPOSE. Tool names get WORK_AGENT_MCP_PREFIX (default mcp__claude_ai_) prepended. precheck: "cost" = code downloads WORK_AGENT_COST_SOURCES and checks them before the model runs; "notice" = code fetches the source texts, the model (no tools) writes, code checks the numbers (office.py). orders: true = also runs whenever `office.py order <role> ...` left work. schedule: daily_at HHMM (KST, first poll cycle at/after that time) or on_demand. desk: folder name under state/office/desks (ASCII, no '-') = Pixel Agents label and areaMappings key.
